subject: Energy
title: How Energy Prices Work
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on How Energy Prices Work.

hook.text: Energy prices are set by supply, demand, and policy—but volatile swings can shake entire economies overnight.

buildup.text: Oil trades on global markets—prices reflect geopolitics, weather, refinery outages, and speculative trading.

discovery.text: Electricity prices vary by hour—cheap when sun and wind are abundant, expensive during evening demand peaks.

twist.text: Negative electricity prices now occur regularly—grids sometimes pay consumers to use power when renewables overproduce.

climax.text: Russia's 2022 gas cuts to Europe caused energy bills to triple across the continent—prices are deeply geopolitical.

punchline.text: Supply, demand, and politics—energy prices move the world.
